title: Contents Insurance Minimums and Storable Items — Storage Rental
content:
Stored contents in every Storage Rental product except the Bike Storage Locker must be covered by the resident's renter's insurance, at a minimum personal property coverage set per product; what may be stored is restricted per product as well.

## Contents coverage

| Storage Rental product | Contents must be covered by renter's insurance | Minimum personal property coverage for stored contents |
|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | No | $0 |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | Yes | $5000 |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | Yes | $5000 |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | Yes | $10000 |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | Yes | $10000 |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | Yes | $15000 |

## Storable items

| Storage Rental product | Fuel, propane or other hazardous materials | Motorcycle, scooter or other motorized vehicle |
|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | Not allowed | Allowed |

Items that may never be stored in any Storage Rental product:

- firearms and ammunition
- perishable food
- live animals
- illegal substances
- flammable liquids

## Points of reference

- The Bike Storage Locker is the only product with no insurance requirement for its contents.
- The minimum coverage steps up with the product: $5000 for the Small Storage Closet (4x4) and the Standard Storage Unit (5x5), $10000 for the two 5 by 10 products, and $15000 for the Oversized Storage Suite (10x10).
- The Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) is the only product in which a motorcycle, scooter or other motorized vehicle may be stored; no product allows hazardous materials.
